commits.subject: Add the token efficiency report.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Profiles the producer with the SDK stream over the 7 eval cases, shows where the tokens go (steps, fixed instruction load, hunk refs, CLI hunting), and proposes file-level refs, a review command that prints the covering diff, and a batched skill workflow measured at -33% tokens.

Co-authored-by: doglotteger <doglotteger@gmail.com>
